candidates.name: Practice Guide 40 supplement 6: other plan-related services and guides
verified_facts: HM Land Registry describes other plan-related services and mapping guidance available to customers.
The page is procedural guidance for plan services rather than a survey dataset.
semantic_limits: Availability of a plan-related service or guide is not parcel-specific geometry or elevation evidence.

candidates.name: Practice Guide 41 supplement 1: estate boundary approval
verified_facts: Estate boundary approval compares a developer's first site survey with the extent of the registered title.
Its purpose includes identifying differences between registered-title boundaries and physical external boundaries early.
semantic_limits: A title-versus-site boundary comparison does not itself validate terrain height, vertical datum, DTM sampling or survey uncertainty.
